design: Exact replication of H2: identical circuits (sha256 a98edb43766579fc13f01415f2263c4f3b702885e211e269d352181a629dd09a), same frozen fit, same backend (ibm_marrakesh) and layout [55, 54, 53, 39, 33, 32]; 4 randomized blocks x 6000 shots; block-order seed 20261011
primary: Same as H2: P(all six qubits return to 0); gp_dd minus the best of {no_dd, xx_qiskit_like, xy4_like} within this run; shot-only 95% CI
pooled: Fixed-effect pooling of the H2 and R1 primary differences, weighted by inverse shot-only variance; reported alongside each run separately
secondary: Observed ranking vs the H2 pre-registered prediction; qubit-54 marginal under gp_dd vs xy4_like and xx_qiskit_like
analysis_script: benchmarks/analyze_ibm_h2.py (tag r1), unchanged except for the tag argument; pooling in benchmarks/pool_ibm_h2.py written before results
stopping_rule: No further runs are added conditional on this outcome; any later run is a new pre-registered study
